# Xiangsheng Genealogy / 相声家谱

> Open-source ink-wash visualization of Chinese crosstalk (相声) master–disciple lineages.

Human-readable docs: README.md (简体中文, default), README.en.md (English).

Xiangsheng Genealogy is a React + Vite + TypeScript + React Three Fiber
app. It maps cited teacher–disciple edges, the generation poem
德寿宝文明, biographies, work titles, and sources. It does not host audio.

## Product

- 3D lineage graph (people as ink nodes, mentor→disciple as ink strokes)
- Camera fly-to and person panel (bio, 字辈, works titles, sources)
- Default path: 朱阔泉 → 侯宝林 → 马季 → 传人
- Optional contrast path: 马三立
- Search + 德/寿/宝/文/明 filters
- Mobile paper / SVG fallback
- Deep links: /p/:id

## Data

- data/people/*.json
- data/edges.json
- data/sources.json
- data/schemas/*.json

Seeded from Wikipedia 「相声演员师承关系」 and cited biographies.
Disputed rows are flagged. Portraits are placeholder / public-domain /
external only.
